newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner Inc Q4 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner Inc Q4 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Net income prior to preferred dividend payments.

1996 results include operations from its acquisition of Turner Broadcasting in October. Time Warner issued 178.4 million shares of common stock, plus 14 million stock options, to Turner Broadcasting shareholders.

Certain assets in cable television, theme parks, broadcasting, motion pictures and television production are held through its 74.49 percent stake in time Warner Entertainment Co LP. Results from Time Warner Entertainment are not consolidated for financial reporting purposes.
Time Warner Entertainment Q4 Revenues: $3.04 billion vs $2.76 billion. Time Warner Entertainment Q4 loss: $1 million vs $3 million.
